Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AMD.
Operating income reached $6.2 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Revenue guidance of $30.2 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2019.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $2.46 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 94 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $2.46 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 4% to 22% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
